_comment: Shared compiler options only. Each app extends this and declares its own
target/lib/module/emit settings, because they genuinely differ: the backend
emits ES2020 Node code with declarations, the frontend bundles ES2022 for
`paths` is deliberately NOT here. TypeScript resolves `paths` relative to
the config file that DECLARES it, not the one that extends it — so a shared
`@/*` in this file would resolve against the repo root instead of each app's
own src/. Both apps keep that mapping in their own tsconfig.
The backend also keeps `moduleResolution: bundler`, which makes tsc emit
rewrites them for Node's ESM loader and is part of the build for that
